text:
Scale-up acknowledged. This cycle sets start_successor=true on all 10 new lanes. Each gets its packet's default task, sharpened where it overlaps or conflicts with work already done, because no owner-desk spec has arrived for any of them. Later desk specs take precedence. Of the original 8 lanes, three get successors: architecture (smwh11dth ended solved), discovery (the coordinator reports smwh11ydr ended solved) and verifier (state unclear; each chat checks ultramath_status itself and starts only if its prior swarm has ended). Geometry, independent, graphs, formal and adversarial are running healthy 8-member swarms or finishing their last member, so they get no message. That makes 13 messages. Every successor is sized 8 members / 200 steps / 180 minutes, deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash, reasoning max.

Your two answers are recorded:
1. EvenWalk rev5 will not be requeued; rev6 is banked.
2. The F4 CNF counts as TESTED_FINITE only. It ships as .txt with sha256 and STATUS.json, and the lane must also run an independent in-swarm certificate check. The research desk runs it locally only if cadical/drat-trim is already installed.

Lean: the CyclicCoreConsumerFromV2 contract check (job 001551-0) FAILED before elaboration. Line 1 is a stray backslash (the staged artifact text begins with a backslash and a newline), which also makes the import invalid. The file's mathematics was never tested. I cannot edit artifacts, and requeuing would fail the same way, so I have re-staged the source and m1's FiveSupport-swap.lean for download and made no Lean proposals this cycle. The serial queue is idle because I had no admissible reviewed artifact. No global chromatic result exists.
summary:
Architecture swarm smwh11dth ended solved with 4 accepted results:
- m1: same-name FiveSupport swap, 455 lines, sha cf08473d.
- m4: branch-free hdis.
- m5: referee pass with 7 live negative controls.
- m6: API risk register.
The hn/hp deletion is refuted: tauto closes goals with `assumption`. The hd/he capture issue is resolved, and v1 step_ban has no further consumers.

Discovery smwh11ydr ended solved, 5 of 6 members accepted. J-depth is at most 3 and the bound is attained; this is proved twice, independently, with a 0.75 s certificate and 12/12 live mutation controls. The I(sigma) table holds on J only (648 counterexamples on W). The result fails at (m,w)=(7,3).

CyclicCoreConsumerFromV2 job 001551-0 failed on the stray leading backslash, so its mathematics is untested.

Running lanes:
- independent smwh32u04: R0 contact table, F4 embedding, reachability.
- graphs smwh366oi: hH relaxation and reconciliation of 933120/1440/3840.
- formal smwh33quq: A6-Bridge-v4; A5Obstruction must be in field form.
- adversarial smwh32yr0: 4-colouring of R0.
- geometry smwh11xw7: m5 still running.

All 10 new lanes are being started. No global chromatic improvement has been proved.
needs_parent: Job claude-lean-20261115t001551-0 (CyclicCoreConsumerFromV2) failed at 1:0 with 'unexpected token backslash'. The staged artifact text begins with a backslash and a newline. Please check whether the download/staging step prepends that character, since the manifest reports the source as 148 lines and 8020 bytes. If staging adds it, please fix staging. The re-download is requested this cycle; I will review it and queue it next cycle.

The local Lean queue is idle this cycle. No reviewed, admissible inbox .lean artifact was supplied, and the only one available fails on the leading-byte defect above. Candidates for next cycle: FiveSupport-swap.lean (as FiveSupportSwap), the corrected contract check, the L-S3 in-place swap, and the discovery J-depth lemma.
